newsitem.title: USA: Destron Fearing cites foreign sales for Q1 gain.
newsitem.headline: Destron Fearing cites foreign sales for Q1 gain.

text.p: Destron Fearing Corp said Wednesday a 28 percent increase in first quarter revenue was due primarily to higher sales overseas.

The company, which makes electronic and visual identification devices for animals, posted revenues of $3.2 million, compared with $2.5 million in the first quarter of 1996. Net income in the period reached $81,000, versus a loss of $302,000 one year ago.
Destron Fearing said the results support a previously anticipated return to profitability in 1997. The company's shares were trading down 4/16 Wednesday at 2-11/16.
